messages:
Alicia Park: Quick heads-up — planning a community launch for the 'Local Inference Starter' refapp. Goal: blog + short benchmark narrative + 60-min webinar + office hours. Need comms, benchmark, and inbound routing. Target week of May 6. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Samir Patel: Timeline works for me. Can we lock benchmark numbers by Tue? I can run runs on p3 and a40 and share charts.
Priya Nair: Love it. For the benchmark narrative keep it simple: latency, tokens/sec, and cost per 1M tokens. Call out config used and reproducible script. Also add a "quick recipe" table.
Marcos Ortega: Demo flow idea — 1) quick local model spin-up (5 min), 2) run sample prompts, 3) compare hosted vs local perf. I'll draft the step-by-step tutorial.
Theo Li: For webinar signup we need 1) name/email, 2) company, 3) approximate usage tier. We'll route to sales via HubSpot list 'oss-refapp-webinar' and tag by company size. I'll share mapping.
Alicia Park: Draft copy for the launch post + tweet:
```
Blog headline: Launching Local Inference Starter — spin up an optimized LLM locally in 5 minutes
Lead: We built a tiny reference app that shows how to run inference locally with Redwood-compatible runtimes, reproducible benches, and a plug-and-play tutorial.
CTA: Try the refapp on GitHub — https://go.redwood.ai/local-starter-launch
Tweet: "New: Local Inference Starter — spin up a refapp, run our benchmark, and see latency/cost tradeoffs. Join our webinar May 8 to walk through it. https://go.redwood.ai/local-starter-launch #opensource #inference"
```
Samir Patel: I'll run the bench suite, log seed, model config, and push csv+png to the doc. Plan to include 99th percentile latency and cost/M tokens.
Priya Nair: We'll include a small A/B prompt set for quality checks. I'll own evals and write a one-page summary for the blog.
Marcos Ortega: Can we add repo labels `good-first-refapp` and `benchmarked`? I'll add GH Actions to run a smoke bench on PRs and post results as artifacts.
Theo Li: Routing plan: HubSpot list -> #sales-inbound via webhook; add property "refapp_interest"; high-volume leads (>100k tokens/mo) tagged enterprise and trigger EOS flow.
DevBot: Calendar event created: "Local Inference Starter: Launch Webinar" — May 8 16:00 UTC — https://cal.link/local-starter-webinar
Alicia Park: Owners: Samir (bench), Marcos (tutorial & repo), Priya (evals), Theo (routing). Blog draft by Fri EOD, slides by Tue, prereg badge for attendees. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: noted, will prioritize bench runs.
Priya Nair: I'll prep the evalset and baseline prompts this week.
Marcos Ortega: I'll open the repo PR with labels and CI today.
Theo Li: I'll post the routing doc in #marketing and share the HubSpot mapping. Anything else?
Alicia Park: Nothing else for now — thanks everyone. We'll sync Wed 10am to review draft and slides.
